description: World extent and tile grid for the Los Santos / Blaine County map.

tile_grid.comment: Tiles are columns through the full Y (vertical) range. GTA V streams the same way: horizontal cells, unbounded vertically, so tunnels and skyscrapers belong to the tile they sit above.

lod_rings.name: hd
lod_rings.comment: Full-detail drawables. Matches the lodDist most GTA V HD archetypes ship with.

lod_rings.name: slod2
lod_rings.comment: -1 means no limit: the distant city skyline stays resident for the whole session.
